args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I like that it's clean and simple, and it's great that you've made it easy to find your contact information. If I could suggest one improvement, it would be to add a bit more content about yourself — for example, a short bio, your interests, or what you do professionally. That would help visitors get to know you better and make the site feel more personal. Overall, nice work!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that your blog has a clear personal touch — it's great to see your passion for hiking come through! If I could offer a suggestion, it would be to expand on that theme: consider adding posts about your favorite hiking trails, tips for beginners, or photos from your adventures. That kind of content would make your blog even more engaging and relatable for readers who share your hobby. Keep up the great work!
